tools.name: a2a_fulfill_quote

tools.description: Pause a subscription (stops billing, can resume later). Requires --apply flag.

tools.name: publish_product_catalog
tools.description: Publish a product to the machine-readable agent catalog. Makes products discoverable by AI agents with capability-based matching, trust levels, and machine-readable specs.

tools.name: publish_wasm_connector
tools.description: Publish a WASM connector to the local marketplace catalog (app-store style ecosystem index).

tools.name: query_agent_catalog
tools.description: Query the agent catalog for products matching filters. Supports capability, trust level, price, fulfillment chain, and category filtering.

tools.name: quote_shipping_rates
tools.description: Quote carrier rates from provider adapters using structured parcel data and destination address.

tools.name: reconcile_payment_provider
tools.description: Reconcile payment intents against settlement records to find pending settlement or over-settlement drift.

tools.name: record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Record payment on an invoice.

tools.name: refund_payment_intent
tools.description: Refund all or part of a captured provider-backed payment intent.

tools.name: register_agent_card
tools.description: Register an AI agent card for A2A commerce. Advertises capabilities, supported networks, and payment assets.

tools.name: reject_return
tools.description: Reject a return request with a reason.

tools.name: release_reservation
tools.description: Release an inventory reservation, returning the reserved quantity to available stock.

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove an item from the cart.

tools.name: reserve_inventory
tools.description: Reserve inventory for an order. Reserved stock is allocated but not yet deducted.

tools.name: resolve_payment_link
tools.description: Resolve a payment link by ID or short code. Returns the link details, items, total, and expiry status.

tools.name: resume_subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused subscription. Requires --apply flag.

tools.name: revoke_payment_link
tools.description: Revoke (cancel) an active payment link. Prevents further checkouts from it.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Send an invoice to the customer.

tools.name: send_purchase_order
tools.description: Send a PO to the supplier.

tools.name: set_base_currency
tools.description: Set the store's base currency.

tools.name: set_cart_payment
tools.description: Set the payment method for a cart.

tools.name: set_cart_shipping_address
tools.description: Set the shipping address for a cart.

tools.name: set_exchange_rate
tools.description: Set or update an exchange rate between two currencies.

tools.name: ship_order
tools.description: Mark an order as shipped with optional tracking number.

tools.name: sign_wasm_connector_attestation
tools.description: Sign a marketplace connector attestation using local signing key material for trustable install/execute verification.

tools.name: skip_billing_cycle
tools.description: Skip the next billing cycle for a subscription. Requires --apply flag.

tools.name: soc2_evidence
tools.description: Generate a SOC2 audit evidence package. Gathers structured evidence for requested controls: access_control, change_management, encryption, monitoring, incident_response.

tools.name: start_work_order
tools.description: Start a work order (begin production).

tools.name: sync_conflicts
tools.description: List unresolved sync conflicts. Conflicts occur when local and remote events modify the same entity concurrently.

tools.name: sync_decrypt_event
tools.description: Decrypt an encrypted sync event from the local outbox or pulled-event store using the local recipient key. Supports legacy X25519 and hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 wraps.

tools.name: sync_entity_history
tools.description: Get the event history for a specific entity from the remote sequencer or the local pulled-event store.

tools.name: sync_full
tools.description: Perform a full sync: push pending events then pull new events. Requires --apply flag for push.

tools.name: sync_inspect_commitment
tools.description: Inspect a VES batch commitment from the sequencer. Shows the Merkle root, sequence range, and event count.

tools.name: sync_outbox
tools.description: List events in the local outbox. Shows pending, synced, failed, and rejected events.

tools.name: sync_pull
tools.description: Pull events from the remote sequencer and store them locally.

tools.name: sync_pulled_events
tools.description: List events already pulled from the sequencer and stored locally. Can optionally include plaintext payloads or decrypt encrypted payloads with local keys.

tools.name: sync_push
tools.description: Push pending local events to the remote sequencer. Requires --apply flag for actual push.

tools.name: sync_rebase
tools.description: Resolve all sync conflicts using a resolution strategy. Requires --apply flag.

tools.name: sync_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a specific sync conflict using a resolution strategy. Requires --apply flag.

tools.name: sync_retry_failed
tools.description: Reset failed events to pending status so they can be retried. Requires --apply flag.

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Get the current sync status between local database and remote sequencer. Shows pending events, sync lag, and connection status.

tools.name: sync_verify_inclusion
tools.description: Verify a Merkle inclusion proof for a VES event. Proves the event is included in a committed batch.

tools.name: sync_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify the signature on a VES event receipt. Supports legacy Ed25519 receipts and hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 bundles.

tools.name: track_shipping_label
tools.description: Track a shipping label by label ID or tracking number.

tools.name: treasury_balance
tools.description: Get treasury balances for an agent.

tools.name: treasury_buy
tools.description: Purchase tokens using treasury stablecoin balances.

tools.name: treasury_deposit
tools.description: Record a treasury deposit for an agent (funds received).

tools.name: treasury_ledger
tools.description: List recent treasury transactions for an agent.

tools.name: treasury_list_tokens
tools.description: List available tokens from chain config and custom registry.

tools.name: treasury_register_token
tools.description: Add or update a token in the treasury registry.

tools.name: uninstall_wasm_connector
tools.description: Uninstall a connector version from the local connector runtime.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Update the quantity of an item in the cart.

tools.name: update_custom_object
tools.description: Update a custom object record. Provide `values` (object) or `valuesJson` (string) to update record values.

tools.name: update_custom_object_type
tools.description: Update a custom object type (schema). Updating fields replaces the full field definition list.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.description: Update the status of an order. Valid statuses: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded.

tools.name: validate_coupon
tools.description: Check if a coupon code is valid and can be used.

tools.name: validate_tax_jurisdiction_compliance
tools.description: Validate jurisdiction readiness for tax calculation (country/state/postal requirements and category checks).

tools.name: vector_clear
tools.description: Clear all vector embeddings for a specific entity type.

tools.name: vector_clear_all
tools.description: Clear all vector embeddings across all entity types.

tools.name: vector_index_all_customers
tools.description: Index all customers in the database for vector search.

tools.name: vector_index_all_inventory
tools.description: Index all inventory items in the database for vector search.

tools.name: vector_index_all_orders
tools.description: Index all orders in the database for vector search.

tools.name: vector_index_all_products
tools.description: Index all products in the database for vector search. This may take a while for large catalogs.

tools.name: vector_index_customer
tools.description: Index a single customer for vector search by their ID.

tools.name: vector_index_inventory
tools.description: Index a single inventory item for vector search by its ID.

tools.name: vector_index_order
tools.description: Index a single order for vector search by its ID.

tools.name: vector_index_product
tools.description: Index a single product for vector search by its ID.

tools.name: vector_reindex_all
tools.description: Rebuild all vector embeddings from scratch. Clears existing embeddings then re-indexes all products, customers, orders, and inventory items. Use this after bulk data imports or to fix stale embeddings.

tools.name: vector_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers using natural language query with hybrid semantic + BM25 ranking.

tools.name: vector_search_inventory
tools.description: Search inventory items using natural language query with hybrid semantic + BM25 ranking.

tools.name: vector_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders using natural language query with hybrid semantic + BM25 ranking.

tools.name: vector_search_products
tools.description: Search products using natural language query with hybrid semantic + BM25 ranking. Returns products sorted by relevance score.

tools.name: vector_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about vector embeddings including counts by entity type.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Verify an AI agent card (admin operation). Upgrades trust level to Verified.

tools.name: verify_chain_anchor
tools.description: Verify that an event proof matches an expected on-chain anchor transaction hash and Merkle root. Confirms the event was committed to the chain.

tools.name: verify_inclusion_proof
tools.description: Verify a Merkle inclusion proof — confirms that a leaf hash is included in a Merkle root.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a VES commerce receipt — checks signature, hash, and Merkle inclusion proof.

tools.name: verify_wasm_connector_attestation
tools.description: Verify connector trust attestation in the marketplace catalog before installation or execution.

tools.name: void_shipping_label
tools.description: Void a shipping label before final delivery.

tools.name: void_tax_transaction
tools.description: Void a committed tax transaction with optional reason.

tools.description: Create an x402 payment intent for AI agent commerce. Returns a signing hash that the payer agent must sign with Ed25519.

tools.name: x402_credit_balance
tools.description: Get x402 credit balance for a payer (prepaid meter for streaming usage).

tools.name: x402_credit_debit
tools.description: Debit x402 balance for metered usage. Requires --apply.

tools.name: x402_credit_deposit
tools.description: Credit (deposit) x402 balance for metered usage. Requires --apply.

tools.name: x402_credit_transactions
tools.description: List x402 credit ledger transactions.

tools.name: x402_execute_agent_payment
tools.description: Execute end-to-end agentic payment: create intent, locally sign with payer agent key, settle on-chain, and optionally record incoming settlement for payee agent.

tools.name: x402_get_intent
tools.description: Get details of an x402 payment intent.

tools.name: x402_get_next_nonce
tools.description: Get the next nonce for a payer address. Used for replay protection.

tools.name: x402_list_intents
tools.description: List x402 payment intents with optional filtering.

tools.name: x402_mark_settled
tools.description: Mark an x402 payment intent as settled on-chain. Called after blockchain confirmation.

tools.name: x402_record_incoming_settlement
tools.description: Record a settled x402 intent as an incoming treasury deposit for a local payee agent.

tools.name: x402_settle_intent_onchain
tools.description: Execute a signed x402 intent on-chain using an agent wallet, then mark the intent as settled.

tools.name: x402_sign_intent
tools.description: Sign an x402 payment intent with an Ed25519 signature. Supports manual signature/public key or local agent-key signing.
